sources.entry: ByteStash - Pastebin and file storage service with a simple web interface. Supports syntax highlighting, optional user authentication and public sharing. (Demo) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: ByteStash is a self-hosted web app for storing, organising and managing code snippets, with optional user accounts, SSO, PostgreSQL support and an MCP endpoint for AI assistants.
summary.what_it_does: ByteStash lets you create, edit and filter code snippets through a web interface, filtering by programming language or by keywords in the content. Snippets are stored in a SQLite database by default, or optionally in PostgreSQL if a connection string or PostgreSQL settings are provided. The Docker setup mounts a data volume and exposes port 5000, with environment variables controlling account creation, token expiry, and base path. It supports OpenID Connect single sign-on with providers such as Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak and Pocket ID. It includes a built-in Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP) that lets AI assistants like Claude, OpenAI and Perplexity search and manage snippets using an API key. A Swagger UI documents the REST API at /api-docs.
use_cases: search snippets by language or content
single sign-on login for a snippet store
let AI assistants access my snippets
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml with the image ghcr.io/jordan-dalby/bytestash:latest and a volume mounted at /data/snippets
Map port 5000:5000 and set environment variables such as BASE_PATH, TOKEN_EXPIRY and PUBLIC_URL as needed
Open the web UI on port 5000 and create an account (unless account creation is disabled)
Optionally configure OIDC_* variables for single sign-on or DATABASE_URL / POSTGRES_* variables for PostgreSQL
Create an API key under Settings → API Keys to use the REST API or MCP endpoint
notable: Optional PostgreSQL backend with a built-in SQLite-to-PostgreSQL migration that keeps IDs so share links and API keys keep working
Built-in MCP endpoint so Claude, OpenAI and Perplexity can read and write snippets with an API key
OpenID Connect SSO support with configurable redirect URLs
Swagger UI for the REST API at /api-docs
Also available through the Unraid App Store and PikaPods
caveats: The MCP endpoint requires HTTPS for remote clients, so a TLS-terminating reverse proxy is needed
Changes made while running on PostgreSQL are not copied back to SQLite
The README's Docker example sets DEBUG to true and ALLOW_NEW_ACCOUNTS to true, which should be reviewed before exposing publicly
